title: derm user settings
description: ~/.derm/settings.json: the user's switches for wave 5 (events.md section 5; the wave 5 base, 4 Nov 2026). derm setup (lane W) writes it, behind one question per switch; derm run, the daemon and the gates read their own key. A missing file or key is the default named here. A file that does not follow this schema is ignored with a warning, and the defaults apply, except `boundary.preAnswer`, which then counts as unset (so a script stops, case 129). User-level only: no project file is read. ~/.derm/ is a control path (policy.md section 4, step 7a).

boundary.description: Lane T (case 129). `preAnswer` answers the no-boundary question when no one can: unset (null) stops; `run-as-you` runs without a boundary; `stop` stops. Off until set; derm status shows it.

tap.description: Lane S. The model tap, on by default (Tony, 4 Nov). `derm run --no-tap` turns it off for one chat (case 127).

content.description: Lane S (cases 85, 126). Content capture, off by default; when on, kept locally for retentionDays (1 to 7), then deleted.

installs.description: Lane X (cases 130 to 134). `check`: the pre-install check, off by default (universal plan section 8, call 10); when on, the daemon calls the project's registry and api.osv.dev only. `minAgeHours`: a version younger than this asks (48, Safe Chain's default, note AT).

computerUse.description: Lane U. Off by default (Tony, 4 Nov), and off in every release until lane V's box test passes.
